title: UI: Color picker component
description: Implement a reusable ColorPicker component in packages/authoring-ui/src/ColorPicker.tsx. Shows a color swatch that when clicked opens a popover with: hex input, RGB sliders, opacity/alpha slider, and a set of Flash 8 default swatches. Props: { color: string, alpha?: number, onChange: (color: string, alpha?: number) => void }. Use native input[type=color] as the base with additional alpha control. Keep it self-contained with useState. Build must pass.
